newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dassault Electronique 96 sales up 7.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dassault Electronique 96 sales up 7.2 pct.

text.p: (All figures in millions of French francs)

NOTE - Dassault Electronique gave its sales figures in a statement. It said the group's results for 1996 would be decided at the next board meeting in April and should be higher than a forecast made at October's meeting, due to non-recurring items which were not included in the October forecast. The group's net attributable profit should benefit from the parent company's healthy results and subsidiaries.

Orders in 1996, marked by a difficult economic context and cuts in the French defence budget, and delays in exports, totalled 3.6 billion francs, compared to 3.7 billion in 1995. The order book stood at 7.2 billion francs at the end of 1996. Exports account for 44 percent of turnover, double that of two years ago.
